descriptionChirho: The proper noun Reuben, referring to Jacob's firstborn son and the Israelite tribe descended from him, including their territorial allotment in Transjordan. All four clusters represent the same name with different prepositional and conjunctional frames: bare noun (69x), ke- (as/like Reuben), le- (for/to Reuben), and waw (and-Reuben). Multilingual evidence is perfectly uniform: Arabic ra'ubiyna (رَأُوبِينَ), Spanish Ruben, Hindi ruben/ra'uben (रूबेन/रऊबेन), Korean reuben (르우벤), and Swahili Reubeni/Rubeni throughout all clusters.
